title: Session event — one line of <scratch>/events.jsonl per tool invocation (contract rule 16)

exit.description: The real exit code (rule 16): one of 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 124 for a tool's own outcomes, or any value 0-255 from a tool that declares passes_exit, which returns the command's exit (discovery revision 9). C7 checks it equals the observed exit

ts.description: Wall-clock time. Written to the log always: rule 11 governs tool OUTPUT, not the event log

t_ms.description: The end, in epoch milliseconds (feature 009, the session journal's order). Optional; ts keeps its form

ppid.description: The tool's parent process: links a tool to the shell command that ran it (feature 009). Optional

agent.description: TIMELIKE_AGENT, when set and valid (feature 009: entries separable by agent). Optional

ref.description: The tool's pointer from its own result data, one key naming its kind: {"log": path} (run) or {"snapshot": id} (snapshot, undo). Declared by Tool(event_ref=...) (feature 009). Optional
